headquarters: Mantralaya, Vallabh Bhawan, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh - 462004
description: The administrative department tasked with land administration, maintenance of land records, revenue collection, disaster management, and issuing critical official certificates to citizens of Madhya Pradesh.
sub_divisions: Commissioner of Land Records and Settlement (CLR MP)
District Revenue Administration (Collectorates, Tehsil & Tappa Offices)
primary_functions: Maintenance, digitization, and updating of land rights records (Khasra, Khatauni, and Maps)
Adjudication of land disputes, demarcation, mutation (Namantaran), and land division (Batwara)
Collection of land revenue, agricultural cess, and execution of land acquisition for public infrastructure
Administration of relief measures during natural calamities, droughts, floods, and crop damage
Supervision of field revenue officials including Sub-Divisional Magistrates (SDM), Tehsildars, and Patwaris
key_services_offered: Issuance of certified Khasra/Khatoni copies and land ownership maps (Bhudesh)
Online tracking of land dispute cases via Revenue Case Management System (RCMS)
Issuance of Caste, Income, Domicile, and Solvency Certificates via MP e-District
Land conversion (Nazul) permissions and agriculture-to-non-agriculture usage approvals
